name: Swordlord Guardian
body:
Dueling schools are known for putting out skilled warriors. Some, while trained to be excellent duelists, are also trained to be nimble bodyguards and protectors. These are the swordlord guardians, master of using the blade to keep their allies safe.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A swordlord guardian is proficient with all martial and simple weapons, the dueling sword and light armor, but no shields. Additionally, they gain Weapon Finesse as a bonus feat.

This ability replaces the vanguard’s normal armor and weapon proficiencies.

Practiced Defense (Ex)

The swordlord guardian gains the following use for Mettle:

The swordlord guardian may expend a point of Mettle to reduce the penalties from fighting defensively or using the Combat Expertise feat by 1. This reduction in penalty stacks with any other reductions to these penalties.

This ability alters mettle.

Combat Expertise (Ex)

At 2nd level, the swordlord defender gains Combat Expertise as a bonus feat even if they do not meet the prerequisites. At 8th level and every 6 levels thereafter, the AC bonus provided by Combat Expertise, fighting defensively or total defense is increased by 1. The swordlord guardian only gets the additional benefit to one source and only while wielding a finesse blade in one hand and nothing in the off-hand. For example, if an 8th-level swordlord guardian is employing Combat Expertise and fighting defensively, the +1 additional AC bonus from this ability is only added once.

This ability replaces shield focus.

What is a Finesse Blade?

A finesse blade is any weapon from the heavy blades or light blades weapon groups that may be used one-handed with Weapon Finesse whether by weapon category, property or an ability or feat. If going for the traditional Paizo intellectual property dueling school this class is based off of, the proper weapon is a dueling sword, but this class is open for more nimble masters of the blade regardless of discipline.

Weapons of the Duelist: At 2nd-level, the swordlord guardian gains Quickdraw and Dueling Mastery as bonus feats. They need not meet the prerequisites for these feats though Quickdraw is only usable with finesse blades and Dueling Mastery is usable with any finesse blade, not just the dueling sword. Additionally, when wielding a finesse blade one-handed, the swordlord guardian may add the Dexterity bonus to damage dealt. However, if the swordlord guardian has levels in classes other than vanguard, the Dexterity bonus applied is restricted to the levels in vanguard. In all cases the Dexterity bonus applied in lieu of Strength is not increased by wielding an otherwise qualifying two-handed weapon.

The swordlord guardian gains the Dueling Style feat as a bonus feat at 7th level and the Dueling Style Aegis feat as a bonus feat at 12th level. Both feats are usable for any finesse blade, not just the dueling sword.

Additionally, the swordlord guardian may take the Dueling Style Conquest feat with a Weapon Focus in any finesse blade instead of Weapon Focus (dueling sword). They must meet all the other prerequisites.

This ability replaces weapons of the guardian.

Defensive Parry (Ex)

At 3rd level, when a swordlord guardian makes a full round attack with a finesse blade, they gain a +1 AC bonus against melee attacks until the beginning of their next turn. This bonus increases by +1 for every 4 levels after 3rd.

This ability replaces armor training gained at 3rd and 15th levels.

Active Defense (Ex)

At 6th level, when using the active defense ability, the swordlord guardian must be wielding a finesse blade. Instead of adding a shield bonus, they may apply their bonus from Combat Expertise, fighting defensively or a total defense action taken during the round. The total bonus applied cannot exceed their vanguard level. Otherwise this ability acts as active defense. This ability modifies active defense.

Display of Skill (Ex)

At 7th level, the swordlord guardian gains Improved Feint and Dazzling Display as bonus feats only usable when wielding a finesse blade and nothing in their off hand. On a successful feint, they may spend a point of Mettle to demoralize their target via an Intimidate check. This demoralize attempt gets a bonus equal to the swordlord guardian’s vanguard levels.

This ability replaces press the advantage.

Steel Net (Ex)

At 7th level, when fighting defensively as a full-round action with a finesse blade, the penalties on all attacks are reduced by 1, and the dodge bonus to AC is increased by 1 for the same round. The attack penalty reduction and the dodge bonus to AC increase by an additional 1 at 11th level and 17th level.

This ability replaces the armor training gained at 7th level.

Duelist’s Bulwark (Ex)

At 9th level, a swordlord guardian can deflect some magic with their skill with the sword. This ability operates as the bulwark ability except that it is only usable when using a finesse blade in one hand and nothing in the off-hand. This ability modifies bulwark.

Evasion (Ex)

At 9th level, a swordlord guardian can avoid even magical and unusual attacks with great agility. If they make a successful Reflex saving throw against an attack that normally deals half damage on a successful save, they instead take no damage. Evasion can be used only if the swordlord guardian is wearing light armor or no armor. A helpless swordlord guardian does not gain the benefit of evasion. If the swordlord guardian has evasion from another source, this instead becomes improved evasion.

This ability replaces brace.

Counterattack (Ex)

At 11th level, a swordlord guardian may make an attack of opportunity as an immediate action against an opponent who hits them in melee, as long as the attacking creature is within the swordlord guardian’s reach.

This ability replaces the armor training gained at 11th level.

Untraceable Blade (Ex)

At 12th level, a swordlord may make a feint attempt as a swift action once per round with a finesse blade in one hand and nothing in the off-hand. This feint attempt can trigger the display of skill ability as normal. This feint attempt gains a bonus equal to the swordlord guardian’s vanguard levels. When activating the display of skill ability with this feint, the vanguard may make a trip or disarm attempt in lieu of using Intimidate to demoralize the target. Those combat maneuvers gain a bonus equal to the vanguard’s class levels when used in this manner.

This ability replaces improved press the advantage.

Extension of the Arm (Ex)

At 19th level, the swordlord guardian gains the second skin ability as normal but it only applies when wielding a finesse blade in one hand, nothing in the off-hand, and when wearing light or no armor. This ability modifies second skin.
